title: Titan Core: Reforged
tagline: Deconstruct, upgrade, and dominate in a cyber arena!
pitch: Engage in fast-paced battles against mechanical titans, tearing them down to collect valuable components. Use your loot to enhance your core abilities in real-time, creating a thrilling loop of risk and reward.
coreLoop: Players fight against a titan, collect components upon victory, and immediately apply these upgrades to enhance their combat capabilities for the next encounter. The loop encourages quick decision-making and rapid growth.

mechanics.name: Component Collection
mechanics.description: Defeated enemies drop components that can be picked up immediately to enhance the player's strength and abilities.

mechanics.name: Titan Encounters
mechanics.description: Face off against clearly defined titan bosses that require strategic movement and attacks to defeat.

mechanics.name: Upgrade System
mechanics.description: Utilize collected components to upgrade player stats or abilities instantly during gameplay.

controls.keyboard: WASD for movement, SPACE for attack
controls.mouse: Click to interact or pick up components

artDirection.backgroundFx: subtle moving grid lines or pulses

difficulty.start: Easy, with slow and predictable titan attacks.
difficulty.progression: Increased titan aggression and complexity of attacks as the player upgrades.
difficulty.peak: Fast-paced encounters with multiple titans and projectiles, requiring precise movement and timing.

winLose.win: Defeat the titan and successfully upgrade your core.
winLose.lose: Player's core is destroyed or health reaches zero.

juice.particles: when collecting components and performing upgrades
juice.hitStop: when a player is hit or delivers a critical attack
juice.flash: when the core upgrades are activated

scopeNotes: No complex AI, no multi-screen arenas, no unnecessary visual clutter, no decorative upgrades. Avoid intricate narratives; gameplay should be immediate and accessible.

scoreEvents: score increases by defeating enemies, collecting components, and successfully upgrading core
